title: Coast Guard rescues 2 after boat sinks 40 miles west of Bradenton
description: A Coast Guard Air Station Clearwater, Florida, MH-60 Jayhawk helicopter crew rescues two men from a sinking boat 40 miles west of Bradenton, Florida, Dec. 12, 2020. A Coast Guard Auxiliary plane located the men clinging to their boat after the men activated their personal locator beacon. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Ashley J. Johnson)
credit: U.S. Coast Guard video by Petty Officer 2nd Class Ashley J. Johnson
